subject.title: fix(session): defer flushPendingToolResults by one event-loop tick

question: Should maintainers require redacted Feishu or comparable production-runner proof before accepting this one-tick flush defer as the fix for the missing-tool-result race?
rationale: The code path and focused tests line up with the reported race, but the user-visible failure is a production session/channel timing issue and the contributor has not shown that path after the fix.

options.title: Require production-path proof
options.body: Ask for redacted Feishu output, runner logs, or an equivalent production-path transcript showing the real tool result is persisted without a synthetic missing-result entry.

options.title: Accept source/test proof risk
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally merge based on source and focused tests, while owning that the reported Feishu path was not proven on the PR head.

options.title: Pause behind canonical issue
options.body: Keep this PR paused behind https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/84134 until a maintainer or contributor can produce the missing proof.

recommendation.title: Require production-path proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted Feishu output, runner logs, or an equivalent production-path transcript showing the real tool result is persisted without a synthetic missing-result entry.

likelyOwner.reason: The central session guard and current cleanup helper history route the proof-sufficiency choice to this session-state area owner signal.
